title: #135 Foreign Language
prompt: In globalization, it is impossible to succeed if you cannot speak a foreign language. Do you agree or disagree?

promptSegments.text: In globalization, it is impossible to succeed if you cannot speak a foreign language.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu rõ mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Bảo vệ quan điểm bằng 2 lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Learning a foreign language is beneficial for career development, as it opens up more job opportunities and allows individuals to interact with a wider range of customers.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, speaking a foreign language facilitates meeting new friends and allows people to immerse themselves in different cultures while traveling.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Language skills are not the only requirement for success in the modern world.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Language skills are crucial for career advancement because knowing another language opens up numerous job opportunities, allowing people to earn more money.

angles.label: Point 2

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Language skills are important for career success because they help people communicate with diverse groups of people, leading to better job opportunities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Knowing a foreign language improves life experiences, especially when traveling, because it allows people to interact more deeply with local cultures.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
